featured_reviews.name: zainab fidai
featured_reviews.review_text: Parth should get involved and understand why buyers who have already purchased a flat are so unhappy because of the delays, false promises, poor quality of work and to add to it the nonchalant behaviour with absolute lack of ownership and responsibility by all his teams involved in this project Artezza.

featured_reviews.name: Yashi Desai
featured_reviews.review_text:
This project has been on hold for the past 8 months. The soft possession was initially promised in May 2025, but the timeline was pushed back. A delay is understandable if work is steadily progressing, however, that is not the case here.

Senior staff members have resigned, and the only people currently present at the office are Ms. Zoya and a few junior staff who are unable to provide any clear explanation on why work has stopped or when it will resume. Mr. Parth continues to assure that soft possession will be given by December, but this timeline feels highly unrealistic and unprofessional.

I recently visited the site and took this photo—it looks exactly the same as it did 8 months ago, with no visible progress. What’s worse is that there has been zero communication from their end to update investors on the status of construction. other projects that started after Artezza are already nearing completion, while this one remains stalled. Mr Parth needs to pause his social media and PR activities and pay attention to his projects

featured_reviews.review_text: We are a apartment complex amidst the hustle bustle of Business District @LowerParel. We are here since 2006 July. featured_reviews.name: John Adwet Raghav
featured_reviews.review_text: We've moved here recently, and can fairly say that the building and its amenities have met our expectations. Open spaces and amenities for kids, elderly and others alike. Comparatively bigger flats, and well maintained garden, podium, equipped gym, spa, sporting facilities, and many other amenities. Excellent security initiatives that make us feel secure. A serene space in the midst of the Mumbai hustle, a hidden wonder.

featured_reviews.name: Kaushal Parikh
featured_reviews.review_text: One of the best societies to live in the locality and one of the earliest societies to offer a plethora of amenities. One of the largest pools and well equipped gyms apart from many indoor and outdoor playing and sport activities available for children and adults. Well maintained gardens and also the building as a whole. Plenty of families have pets and the society has a very pet friendly culture. I have been living here since 2009 and over the past 16 years we have been very secure with a robust security system alongwith fantastic and friendly neighbours who have made this a beautiful community to live in.

featured_reviews.name: Anilkumar Karimbanakkal
featured_reviews.review_text: The Lodha World One is one of the tower in 3 skyscraper Lodha World Tower. This is the first project recieved possesion among 3. The other  2 are World Crest and World View. The project has started a decade ago and delayed very much. Many contractors had involved in this project; i.e. ACC, Simplex, Capacite and their own company Shreeniwas cotton mills now known as Macrotech. Now the final tower is also about to get ready for possesion. Initially they had planned to construct 113 storey building however they haven't recieved approval from Mumbai airport authority and they granted only 83 storey. These 3 towers are spread in 17 acre land near by Kamala Mills compound. Feels like it's a different World once we enter in the premise. All tower has huge parking area and very difficult to find the way for a new comer, just imagine the size of building. It's World class luxurious residential apartment and focusing only for super class people.
